claims.text: A lead who hasn't booked in 60 to 180 days is still in the CRM and can be reactivated
The three-message reactivation sequence (Day 0, Day 4, Day 10) shown here
FCC adopted order 26-67 on September 30, 2026 replacing the prior revoke-all rule
Under the new order, a STOP on an informational text can apply only to that category while a STOP on marketing still revokes all marketing
The rule change is not yet in effect and starts 30 days after Federal Register publication
Sorting automated texts into informational vs marketing buckets and standardizing one opt-out word is a reasonable prep step

disclosure: Source: Google's September 2026 Small Business Bulletin, confirmed live Oct 5, 2026 (Google Small Business account; reported by Search Engine Journal, Search Engine Roundtable)

claims.text: Google Business Profile post view counts are rolling out globally, shown on each post card in the dashboard
Counts cover posts published in the past 18 months and combine views from Search and Maps into one number
The view count is not yet available through the Business Profile API
A view count shows attention but not whether the viewer called, booked, or became a customer
